g.text: Follow the canyon from Split Peak; search the side alcove by
Stone Ring, before the dead end.
Follow the canyon from Needle; search the side alcove by Broken
From Twin Pillars, use Arch to find the hub; ignore the Stone
Ring dead end and search the side pocket.
The ridge beyond Twin Pillars reveals the treasure below;
return to the fork and follow the wash under Broken Bridge.
The ridge beyond Needle reveals the treasure below; return to
the fork and follow the wash under Broken Bridge.

From Needle, weave between three routes: cross at Arch, then
use the Stone Ring to reach the far end.
From Needle, use Arch to find the hub; ignore the Stone Ring
dead end and search the side pocket.
From Twin Pillars, take the outer loop past Arch; the shortcut
skips the treasure pocket near the second landmark.
